spec.title: Driver Pods Up
spec.description: Driver pods with a fresh process metric sample (stale after ~5m without a scrape); 0 when every instance is stopped.

spec.expr: count(group by (namespace, pod) (mldp_pvxs_driver_process_threads{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"})) or vector(0)

spec.title: Reader Events / s
spec.description: Events produced by all readers (rate of reader_events_total).

spec.title: Writer Failures (range)
spec.description: Writer push/write failures in the selected time range. Should be 0.

spec.title: Writer Queue Depth
spec.description: Items waiting in the MLDP writer queue. Values near queue-capacity (10000) mean the ingestion service is the bottleneck.

spec.title: Reader Event Rate
spec.description: EPICS updates received vs events converted and pushed to the controller bus.

spec.title: Reader Errors
spec.description: Reader failures per second.

spec.title: Reader Processing Time
spec.description: Time to convert one EPICS update into DataBatches (histogram, ms).

spec.title: Reader Queues
spec.description: PV updates waiting for processing and conversion tasks waiting in the reader thread pool.

spec.title: Reader Data Throughput (top 10 PVs)
spec.description: Raw in-memory DataBatch bytes per second, per source PV.

spec.title: Controller Queues
spec.description: Controller bus queue (queue_capacity in config) and per-worker channel queues.

spec.title: Controller Send Time
spec.description: Time to hand an EventBatch from the bus to the writers (histogram, s).

spec.title: Writer Pushes / Failures
spec.description: Requests pushed to MLDP and push/write failures, per writer.

spec.title: Writer Queue Depth
spec.description: MLDP writer queue over time. Steady values near queue-capacity (10000) mean back-pressure from the ingestion service.

spec.title: Writer Throughput
spec.description: Protobuf bytes sent to MLDP vs raw DataBatch bytes delivered to the writer.

spec.title: Writer Stream Rotations
spec.description: gRPC stream open/close cycles by reason (frames, bytes, age...).

spec.title: gRPC Connection Pool
spec.description: MLDP ingestion connections in use vs idle.

spec.title: Writer Payload Throughput (top 10 PVs)
spec.description: Protobuf bytes per second sent to MLDP, per source PV.

spec.title: Process CPU
spec.description: CPU used by the driver process, in cores (clock ticks assumed 100/s). Limit is 2 cores.

spec.title: Process Memory
spec.description: Resident and virtual memory. The container limit is 4 GiB.

spec.title: Threads / Open FDs
spec.description: Thread count and open file descriptors.

spec.title: Process I/O
spec.description: Bytes read and written by the process (includes the shard-slot SQLite file).
